Clint Eastwood Breaks Down After Revealing How Musk’s Research Detected And Reversed His Early Silent Alzheimer’s

The 60 Minutes episode that was taken down seven times — and the 1978 NASA protocol that reversed Clint Eastwood’s silent Alzheimer’s.

Updated Nov. 16, 2026, 9:15 AM UTC / Source: TODAY

Anderson Cooper

Health & Wellness Reporter

Clint Eastwood, 95, during the 60 Minutes interview about the silent Alzheimer's that was erasing his mind.

Add to Google

The world watched in shock as Clint Eastwood — 95-year-old Hollywood legend — broke down sobbing on 60 Minutes about the silent Alzheimer’s that was erasing his mind, before Elon Musk’s research caught it and reversed it.

“I thought it was just age,” Clint revealed, voice cracking. “I was forgetting names I’d known for decades. My mind would just freeze — and everyone looked at me with that pity, like they were already preparing to lose me. And the answer was sitting in my medicine cabinet the whole time. Nobody told me.”

So, if you’re struggling to remember names and faces as you get older… if you’re terrified you’re losing your mind the same way…

You’re NOT alone. And it’s not your fault.

After his diagnosis, Clint was shown the research of Elon Musk — the SpaceX and Neuralink founder who, after watching a 12-year member of his own team disappear to dementia, used his government data access to uncover a buried 1978 NASA archive: a cognitive protocol classified for nearly half a century.

What Musk found changed everything neuroscience believed — and it’s now helping thousands of families avoid the same heartbreak.

Clint Eastwood & Elon Musk.

After the 60 Minutes episode went viral and millions of Americans started asking “Why didn’t my doctor tell me about this?” — our team reached out to Elon Musk for an exclusive follow-up interview.

Musk’s video had already been taken down seven times, but he agreed to share the complete step-by-step protocol that Clint Eastwood is now using every single morning.

Lesley Stahl opened the follow-up interview.

Lesley Stahl: “Elon, the response to our 60 Minutes episode was overwhelming. Millions of Americans watched Clint Eastwood’s story and want to know — is this something anyone can do at home?”

Elon Musk revealed what only a fraction of doctors know about memory loss.

Elon Musk: “The truth that only a fraction of doctors know: memory loss isn’t just age or genetics — it’s a parasite silently feeding on your brain.

The neural parasite is microplastic — invisible plastic nanoparticles present in our food, water, and air. They cross the blood-brain barrier, lodge around your neurons, and block the glymphatic system that cleans your brain every night. As they accumulate, your memories get blocked, not erased.

That is the real cause of Alzheimer’s and dementia. And that is why every medication on the market has failed — Aricept, Namenda, Leqembi at $26,500 a year — they were never designed to remove it.”

Lesley Stahl asked about Clint Eastwood's recovery.

Lesley Stahl: “And Clint Eastwood — that’s what he used to reverse his condition?”

The 1978 NASA Beta-7 archive and the compound inside Vicks VapoRub.

Elon Musk: “Exactly. A simple ritual built around a compound NASA identified in the 1978 Beta-7 archive — a compound that has sat in Vicks VapoRub for over a century. When used the right way, it dissolves the microplastic blockage and lets the brain clean and reconnect itself.

Clint told me the fog lifted in about three weeks. The names came back, the words came back. His family was in tears — happy tears this time.”

"Can anyone try this at home?"

Lesley Stahl: “Can anyone try this at home?”

NASA buried the protocol for 50 years because the main ingredient can't be patented.

Elon Musk: “You probably have this product in your medicine cabinet right now. Most people begin noticing changes within days — the fog lifting, names coming back, that sharpness you thought was gone forever.

NASA buried this for 50 years because the main ingredient can’t be patented and any American can buy it without a prescription. I’ve been building rockets and brain implants for two decades — and this is the most important thing I’ve ever put my name on.”

The full documentary explains the exact compound, steps and quantities.

Lesley Stahl: “This is incredible. Our team has prepared a full documentary here on 60 Minutes explaining exactly how to prepare this ritual at home — the exact compound, the specific steps, and the precise quantities for those watching at home. Watch it below.”

“Please share this video with your friends and loved ones. Together, we have the power to help as many seniors as possible discover the truth about dementia and Alzheimer’s — before it’s too late.”

See Other Celebrities Who Also Regained Mental Clarity

Morgan Freeman

Morgan Freeman says the simple ritual practically saved his career.

“I was turning down roles in Hollywood because the fog was constant. I just didn’t trust my own mind anymore. Within weeks of starting this protocol, everything changed. I called my agent the very next day. This simple ritual practically saved my career.”

Anthony Hopkins

Anthony Hopkins says that at 86, his mind is sharper than it has any right to be.

“When I started studying the script for The Father, the lines simply wouldn’t stick. I was forgetting names, conversations, basic things. After this protocol, I performed that role with full clarity. At 86, my mind is sharper than it has any right to be.”

Robert De Niro

Robert De Niro says the protocol gave him his confidence back.

“There was a point where I was seriously considering stepping away from acting. The memory lapses were becoming impossible to hide on set. This protocol gave me my confidence back. I’m 80 years old and I have no intention of stopping.”

We invited Elon Musk to reveal all the details of this NASA protocol. He shared — for free — exactly how to prepare this recipe at home, why it is so effective, and much more.
